summary: This is a large collection of Poe's short stories and tales, with a short life of Poe at the front. It ranges across Gothic horror, detective fiction, science fiction, satire and comedy. Among its best-known pieces are Ligeia, The Fall of the House of Usher, The Murders in the Rue Morgue, A Descent Into the Maelström, The Masque of the Red Death, The Telltale Heart, The Purloined Letter and The Cask of Amontillado. In Usher a narrator visits a decaying mansion and the family collapses with the house.
context: Poe wrote mostly short stories and poems for magazines and periodicals such as the Southern Literary Messenger and Graham's Magazine, and he is counted among the first successful practitioners of the short story and a pioneer of detective fiction. The Fall of the House of Usher first appeared in Burton's Gentleman's Magazine in September 1839 and was collected in Tales of the Grotesque and Arabesque in 1840. The Standard Ebooks edition gathers the stories in a single volume of about 318,000 words.

people.name: Edgar Allan Poe
people.note: American writer and critic (1809 to 1849), a pioneer of detective fiction and an early master of the short story.

people.name: Roderick Usher
people.note: The ill childhood friend whose mansion the narrator visits.

people.name: Madeline Usher
people.note: Roderick's sister, buried alive in the family tomb and later escaping it.

people.name: John Allan
people.note: The Richmond man who took in the orphaned Poe but never formally adopted him.

people.name: Washington Irving
people.note: Wrote Poe on 6 November 1839 that Usher laid on too much colouring.

people.name: Herman Melville
people.note: John McAleer held that the flawed Ahab drew on the force of the Usher house.

people.name: G. R. Thomson
people.note: Called Usher a masterpiece of Gothic horror, dramatic irony and structural symbolism.

ideas.title: Gothic horror and madness
ideas.note: Usher and many other tales turn on madness, family, isolation and the fear of burial.

ideas.title: Early detective fiction
ideas.note: Poe is credited as a pioneer of the detective genre, and the collection includes his detective tales.

ideas.title: Range of genres
ideas.note: The tales jump between Gothic horror, science fiction, satire, humor and mystery.
